action: Successfully completed momentum holding-period sensitivity test with a fixed lookback-5 signal across 6 predeclared holding periods (1,2,3,5,7,10 days). The test followed the existing walk-forward/null methodology with realistic cost modeling, comprehensive validation (manifest integrity, preflight, leakage review, fill-equity audit), and independent verification. All holding periods showed consistent positive performance with median log returns of ~6.35% and 127/170 positive OOS folds each.
bottleneck: The current evidence is strongest for one-day holding, so temporal robustness is still partly unresolved.
